# dim_intake_forms

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_intake_forms` · dbt area: `portal`

Dimension table for intake forms, which advisors share in order to collect information about potential clients. Each row represents a unique form created (note a single form may have multiple responses). Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The User ID of the Advisor who created the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `archived_at` | When the intake form was archived by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `certification_when_intake_form_created` | The estimated certification level of the advisor when the Intake Form was created. This uses an approximate date of certification based on history table in Eastern Time ('America/New_York'), and may be off by 1-2 days. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_id` | Foreign Key. The unique identifier for the Contact who the form was created for (null for generic). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `contacts_completed_intake_count` | Count of distinct contacts who completed this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `contacts_completed_trip_inquiry_count` | Count of distinct contacts who completed this intake form, including a trip inquiry. This includes instances where a trip inquiry was required by the Advisor and when a Contact opted in to share a trip inquiry. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `contacts_started_intake_count` | Count of distinct contacts who started (completed at least 1 page of) this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `contacts_started_trip_inquiry_count` | Count of distinct contacts who started (completed at least 1 page of) this intake form, including a trip inquiry. This includes instances where a trip inquiry was required by the Advisor and when a Contact opted in to share a trip inquiry. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the Advisor created the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `disabled_at` | Timestamp when the intake form was disabled by an Advisor, preventing new submissions. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `intake_form_first_completed_at` | Timestamp when the first contact completed this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `intake_form_first_in_progress_at` | Timestamp when the first contact started this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `intake_form_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID for each Intake Form created. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `intake_form_last_completed_at` | Timestamp when the most recent contact completed this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `intake_form_last_in_progress_at` | Timestamp when the most recent contact started this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_trip_inquiry_required` | Boolean flag indicating whether the Advisor requires contacts to complete a trip inquiry section. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True/False flag of whether the intake form has been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_generic` | Boolean flag indicating whether this is a generic intake form (not client-specific). True when client_id is null. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_from_via` | True/False flag of whether the intake form was created by the Via AI agent. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `name` | Display name of the intake form as set by the Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `pages_included` | Array of page names that the Advisor configured as visible in the intake form (e.g., ['basic_info', 'trip_basics', 'companions']). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `pages_included_string` | A string list of page names that the Advisor configured as visible in the intake form (e.g., 'basic_info', 'trip_basics', 'companions'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `pages_included_count` | Count of pages the Advisor configured as visible in the intake form definition. Calculated by counting pages in the pages_included array. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `short_id` | Foreign Key. Short alphanumeric identifier for the intake form, used in URLs sent to contacts. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `total_pages_completed_count` | Aggregate count of all pages completed across all responses to this intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `total_time_to_complete_secs` | Total time across all completions of this intake form, measured in seconds. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_intake_form_first_completed_at` | Timestamp when the first contact completed this intake form, including a trip inquiry (either required by the Advisor or opted in by the Contact). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_intake_form_first_in_progress_at` | Timestamp when the first contact started this intake form including a trip inquiry (either required by the Advisor or opted in by the Contact). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_intake_form_last_completed_at` | Timestamp when the most recent contact completed this intake form including a trip inquiry (either required by the Advisor or opted in by the Contact). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_intake_form_last_in_progress_at` | Timestamp when the most recent contact started this intake form including a trip inquiry (either required by the Advisor or opted in by the Contact). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `version` | Intake form release version name. >> SOURCE - Portal |
